sources.title: text-image-retrieval · GitHub Topics · GitHub
sources.snippet: A PyTorch framework for learning aligned image-text representations using frozen pretrained vision and language encoders with trainable adaptors. Inspired by Sigmoid Loss for Language Image Pre-Training (SigLIP), the project provides configurable training, retrieval, and data-processing tools for multimodal representation learning.

sources.title: All You Need to Know About Training Image Retrieval Models
sources.snippet: Image retrieval is the task of finding images in a database that are most similar to a given query image. The performance of an image retrieval pipeline depends on many training-time factors, including the embedding model architecture, loss function, data sampler, mining function, learning rate(s), and batch size. sources.title: Image-text Retrieval: A Survey on Recent Research and Development
sources.snippet: In the past few years, cross-modal image-text retrieval (ITR) has experienced increased interest in the research community due to its excellent research value and broad real-world application. It is designed for the scenarios where the queries are from one modality and the retrieval galleries from another modality.
